d: The role will provide specialist geotechnical expertise for marine and coastal developments such as reclamation works, breakwaters, quay walls, ports, harbors, jetties and related structures in Oman. Responsibilities include field investigations, analytical design, construction support and close coordination with multidisciplinary project teams to ensure safe, cost‑effective delivery of complex maritime infrastructure.
q: BSc/MSc in Civil or Geotechnical Engineering.
Minimum 10 years of experience in marine/coastal geotechnical engineering.
Proven track record on reclamation, breakwater, port and harbor projects.
Proficiency with geotechnical software (e.g., Plaxis, GeoStudio, FLAC).
Knowledge of Omani and international geotechnical design codes and standards.
Strong technical report writing and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary project teams.
Fluent English (Arabic language skills are a plus).
Willingness to travel to project sites in Oman as required.
Professional Engineer registration (PE, UAE, Oman) preferred.
r: li
Plan and execute marine and coastal site investigations (boreholes, CPT, sampling, in‑situ testing).
li
Perform geotechnical analyses and design for reclamation, breakwaters, quay walls, ports, jetties and associated structures.
li
Prepare detailed geotechnical reports, design calculations, and technical specifications.
li
Review and comment on design packages submitted by consultants and internal teams.
li
Provide on‑site construction support, including monitoring, troubleshooting and design modifications.
li
Coordinate with structural, hydraulic, environmental and other discipline engineers to integrate geotechnical solutions.
li
Ensure compliance with Omani regulations, international codes and WSP quality standards.
li
Maintain and manage geotechnical data, databases and project documentation.
li
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge‑sharing within the team.
li
Assist in business development activities, proposal preparation and client presentations.

q: Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain Secret

SAIC is seeking a RF Engineer a position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and Al Jubail, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia that will provide installation and integration support for C4I System racks and components for the Royal Saudi Naval Forces (RSNF). This position is field-based, requiring hands-on work in operational environments rather than being conducted in a traditional office or laboratory setting.
The RF Engineer will be responsible for but not limited to the following Job Duties

Work within the Technical Support Center responsible for system communications verification and perform RF cabling, terminations and operational testing during installations of systems into RSNF vessels, command centers and training facilities.
Experience conducting Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) surveys before an installation to establish the current EMI baseline.
Experience with post-installation surveys to determine any EMI changes after equipment installation.
Experience preparing EMI Summary reports following each survey detailing all EMI findings and recommendations for improvement.
Work with engineering for system design, software installation and equipment operational testing, and provide solutions for areas that might be in need of improvement.
When in between segments of the project, work on construction of test cables and preparation for the next segment of the project.
Review RF quality issues, report on findings, and then update documentation to reflect the approved corrective action.
Maintain, repair, and perform functional communication circuit checks of Radio (UHF, VHF, HF, VSAT, UHF SATCOM, LINK-11/16), installed on ashore and afloat platforms of the RSNF.
Use specialized test equipment and software-controlled diagnostics to isolate malfunctions.
Repair systems according to technical orders, manufacturer's handbooks and local procedures. Accomplish equipment modifications and installation according to engineering change plans.
Repairs and troubleshooting down to component level to include ESD handling.
Soldering using a 3M workstation or portable soldering iron. RF and Fiber optic cable termination and testing.
Provide technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
Frequent inter-organizational and outside customer contacts.
Represent organization in providing solutions to difficult technical issues associated with specific projects.
Bachelor's degree is required in accordance with the contractual requirements of the country, along with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance; An active Secret clearance is preferred; US Citizenship required.
System hardware equipment installation, maintenance and repairs experience.

Familiarity with installation and configuration capabilities of the following software Microsoft Windows (Windows 7/10), Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, Visio), AutoCAD, ADSI, and/or CENTRIXS.
Knowledge of Radio (UHF, VHF, HF, VSAT, KVH SATCOM, NTDS/TADIL Data Links), Networking (Cisco IOS), UPS (APC, Clary), GPS, CENTRIXS, GCCS-M/J, ADSI, SY-117G, and RF7800 series radios.
Repairs and troubleshooting down to component level to include ESD handling.
Soldering using a 3M workstation or portable soldering iron.
Familiarity with test and configuration of KG-250 and similar RF communication protection devices.
Fiber optic cable termination and testing.
Target salary range $120,001 - $160,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.
